app: Fern & Co — A small indoor-plant shop: browse the greenhouse shelf, build your crate, check out, and track your orders.
subtitle: A small indoor-plant shop: browse the greenhouse shelf, build your crate, check out, and track your orders.

_derived.note: Generated by engine/intake/derive.mjs from a product brief. Roles, capabilities and composition are inferences, not declarations.
requirements: The home screen is a photo-led gallery of every plant on the shelf.
Customers can search plants by name.
Customers can filter plants by type.
Customers can filter plants by light.
A customer can save a plant to favourites with a heart toggle.
Customers add plants to a bag from the shelf and from each plant's page, and adjust quantities in the bag before ordering.
Opening a plant shows its care notes, price, rating and size.
A customer checks out from the bag and places an order in three steps: your name and phone, then your delivery address, then review.
A placed order ends with a confirmation showing a reference the customer can quote.
Customers can review their placed orders and cancel an order they no longer want.
